head: MONO
dzh: 网格底、细线框、尺寸标注，像工程图纸
den: Grid paper, hairline frames and dimension marks, like a technical drawing
nzh: 把结构露出来：细线框、网格底、尺寸标注和编号，像工程图纸；只用一个主蓝和一个警示橙，其余全靠线；块不加阴影不加圆角，用 1px 线分区；数字、标签用等宽字，标题可以很大
nen: Expose the structure: hairlines, grid paper, dimension marks and numbering; one blue plus one warning orange, everything else is line work; no shadows or radii, split areas with 1px rules; monospace for numbers and labels, headings can go big
bgImage: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #E4EBF4 0, #E4EBF4 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 24px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #E4EBF4 0, #E4EBF4 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 24px)
